# RNBO codebox ranges, routes, converters and fast math

These 47 original MIT-authored source forms use RNBO `codebox~`, not GenExpr. Every standalone `.rnbo` body equals the code embedded in its five-box stereo FX patch. The initial 45 direct-call forms remain intact, including actual rejected calls. Two additional, separately authored MIDI converter forms declare two `@state` instances and call `.next(input, 440)`; they do not replace or disguise a rejected direct call.

`catalog.json` records exact spelling, API syntax, independent model ID 400–442, primary registry fingerprints and predeclared limits. Unary calls operate per lane, ordinary binary calls reverse arguments on the right, and Cartesian/polar tuples expose their documented output pair. Interpolation and conditional programs use the explicit source routing recorded in each body. Boolean controls are only 0/1 in this batch; other selector conventions are not inferred.

`reference.py` uses independent finite mathematical definitions. Exact dyadic ranges, comparisons, payload passes and reverse arithmetic use zero numerical tolerance. Ordinary functions use `2e-6`; unit converters use `5e-4`; fast functions including `log2f` use a `1e-3` screen against ideal math. The fast threshold is a smoke screen, not a documented accuracy guarantee. Tolerances and input domains precede hardware output. Scale extrapolates; smoothstep uses `(left edge, right edge, phase)`; signed remainder truncates its quotient. No result fitting or DSP change is made.

MIDI input includes practical notes, A4 and quarter tones. Frequency-to-MIDI expectations explicitly use its documented default `round=true`, with no half-note ties; they do not inherit the prior GenExpr continuous-reference policy. Tuning is explicitly 440. Both default MIDI converter options and resources are preserved. `cosT8` uses inputs in [-1,1]; `cosT8safe` uses selected values near zero and ±2π. Other domains avoid undefined/nonfinite outputs. Operation zero signs remain diagnostic. Each stateless result repeats across twenty callbacks; automatic preparation warmup is zero to keep the first audio inputs within each declared domain.

Actual generated-resource inspection precedes arena selection. The valid `mtof` instance form has one shared default 65,536-sample Float32 table, used by two views; this batch selects a 1 MiB structural module arena ceiling. That is not measured memory use. No table is removed. The other accepted forms declare no DataRefs. Construction, allocation, actual memory and callback timing remain distinct from compiler/link acceptance.

Portable tests are in `tools/test_smoke_rnbo_codebox_range_reference.py`. Ignored `build/research/rnbo-codebox-range-smoke-v1` preserves the original export attempts and initial pre-build directory-name rejection. `...-v2` retains the two new instance exports, byte-identical staging of the 42 original prepared exports, the resource preflight, and final module results. The uppercase `cosT8` source spelling remains exact; its module directory ID is lowercase as required by the unchanged module builder. Generated RNBO C++ is private.

These are short source-form functionality checks, not complete mode, alias, event/reset, floating-environment or input-domain qualification. A valid instance result and a rejected direct call can coexist. Hardware execution and publication are separate steps. Build wall time is not DSP performance.

The [XIAO hardware run](../../../../evidence/xiao-smoke-rnbo-codebox-range.json) completes 40 programs: 36 pass, `step` differs from the declared comparison reference, and three fast functions exceed the predeclared ideal-math screen. Six callback costs are queued for CPU review; all memory/allocation gates pass.

The separately authored stateful `mtof` and `ftom` instance tests both pass. Their earlier direct-call rejections remain in the evidence, alongside the `switch` frontend rejection and four C++ failures. Each executed module reserves a 1 MiB arena ceiling; only `mtof` uses arena storage, peaking at 262,256 bytes with its default lookup table retained.
